content.short: Co-Museum is a decentralized NFT collective that enables community-led ownership and curation of rare cultural artifacts and digital art.
content.description: Co-Museum is an innovative art and culture collective that uses blockchain technology to bridge the gap between physical artifacts and digital ownership. By allowing community members to co-own rare relics and historical art pieces through NFTs, it creates a decentralized museum experience where everyone can participate in curation. Built within the Mantle ecosystem, Co-Museum leverages on-chain governance to allow its members to collectively decide the future of their shared cultural treasury.
content.meta: Co-Museum is a decentralized collective for digital and cultural artifact ownership on Mantle. Discover Co-Museum on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
